adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the diff changes member removal to `group.users.delete(user_id)` (passing an integer id). On an association (`group.users`), `delete(id)` is resolved via an association lookup; if the user_id is not currently in that association scope (i.e., not a member), Rails can raise `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound` rather than no-op. The prior PATCH-based path removed members by first `find_by_username` and then calling `group.remove(user)`, which would silently do nothing if the user wasn’t in the group. No rescue/guard exists in the new code, so this is a behavior regression exposed by the diff.
